findings: The fixed engine logs No editable parent when mEditableParent is null and returns false from hasEditableParent; several native callbacks share this guard.
Both APIs emitted one warning in passive initial opening, before editor focus or any commit; a commit is not a necessary trigger.
No additional warning was observed during blank navigation, focus-only, native commit, retained switching or Activity recreation in this run.
After full process exit the warning reappeared during restoration, while actual DOM/editor models and saved reading positions were restored correctly.
This is not proof of the precise native caller or harmlessness in every workload; the kernel was not modified and warnings were not suppressed.
Two-page control counts must not be compared as a reduction against the previous four-page 17-case suite.
